## Rule

**Quadrant priority-overlay** (decoded from LIVE graph + officials, certified against generator
source `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_75b8110e.py`): input is ALWAYS 8×8 (top-left of canvas),
four 4×4 quadrants holding scattered pixels of one fixed color each — TL=4, TR=5, BL=6, BR=9.
Output is the 4×4 per-cell overlay with priority **TR(5) > BL(6) > BR(9) > TL(4) > bg(0)**
(generator writes output in loop order `[0,3,2,1]`, later wins).

Generator-certified invariants (also corpus-verified on 200k: 0 violations):
- size=4 fixed ⇒ input always 8×8, output always 4×4;
- quadrant PURITY: quadrant q contains only {0, color_q} (writes are `grid[4*ro+r][4*co+c]=color_q`);
- input alphabet exactly {0,4,5,6,9}.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = np.zeros((4,4), int)
for q, color in [((0,0),4), ((1,1),9), ((1,0),6), ((0,1),5)]:   # ascending priority
    blk = grid[q[0]*4:(q[0]+1)*4, q[1]*4:(q[1]+1)*4]
    out[blk == color] = color
```

## Cost analysis

LIVE 9,688 = 9,616 memory (Slice crop [1,10,8,8] 2,560 B + 2×[1,10,4,8] gathers 2,560 B +
5×640 B quadrant stacks + class concat/conv) + 72 params — it materializes full-channel
crops it never needs.

The whole rule is **4 single-channel taps + linear priority logic + placement**, which a single
`Conv(kernel 2×2, dilations 4, pads=[0,0,4,4])` computes with ZERO intermediates (#68-ADDENDUM
params-only single-node class; input/output tensors are free):
- taps t00..t11 = the 4 quadrant cells for output (r,c) ∈ [0,4)²;
- signed weights (#69): ch_k = mask_k − 2·Σ(higher-priority masks);
- v1 (no purity assumption): bg + block-confinement via the **one-hot-sum identity**
  (Σ_ic in(ic,t) = 1 at any in-grid cell, 0 outside) as a data-derived constant:
  ch0 = −IG(t00)+IG(t01)+IG(t10)+IG(t11) − 2Σmasks; each color channel gets −IG(t00)+IG(t11)
  to kill ghost fires off the 4×4 block. W [10,10,2,2] = 400 params, no bias.
- v2 (purity-certified): groups=2 halves W. g0 (in 0-4): ch0 = Σ_taps in0 − 3,
  ch4 = in4(t00) + 2·in0(t01)+2·in0(t10)+2·in0(t11) − 6 ("colored == not bg" under purity);
  g1 (in 5-9): ch5 = in5(t01); ch6 = in6(t10) − 2·in5(t01); ch9 = in9(t11) − 2·in5(t01) − 2·in6(t10).
  Biases ≤ 0 ⇒ outside-canvas safe. W [10,5,2,2] = 200 + B [10] = 10 ⇒ **210**.

## Floor proof (210, formulation-enumerated per #68)

Single-node families able to write `output` [1,10,30,30] from `input` (all others priced/killed):
- **Conv** — the ONLY single-node family with cross-channel + spatially-shifted reads.
  groups=1: 400+0 (v1). groups=2: 200+10 (v2). groups=5: KILLED — ch4 needs in0 (g0) AND
  in5/in6/in9-equivalents; with C/g=2 partition {4,5}, BL/BR-presence is invisible (BL cell ∈
  {0,6}: both in4=in5=0). groups=10: KILLED — priority is cross-channel by definition.
  Bias-free groups=2: KILLED by LP infeasibility — g0's only nonzero reads are
  {in0(t00), in4(t00), in0(t01), in0(t10), in0(t11)} (in1-3 ≡ 0 by alphabet; in4 ≡ 0 off-TL by
  purity). Ghost-safety at (r≥4,c<4) forces coeff(in0(t01)) ≤ 0, at (r<4,c≥4) forces
  coeff(in0(t10)) ≤ 0, so all-bg ⇒ coeff(in0(t11)) ≥ 3; but the TR-colored case then gives
  ch0 = −2 + e ≤ 0 ⇒ e ≤ 2. Contradiction — no linear bias-free ch0 exists. Bias mandatory.
- **QLinearConv** — params ≥ 200+10+6 q-scalars = 216 > 210 (params count elements, dtype-blind).
- **MatMul/Gemm/Einsum** — no spatial shift; reshape needs a charged intermediate. DEAD.
- **Gather*/Scatter*/OneHot** — copy/index semantics can't synthesize the one-hot decode without
  a charged index/canvas plane (idx initializer [1,10,30,30]-scale = params explosion). DEAD.
- **Pool/Resize/D2S/elementwise** — no channel mixing / no logic. DEAD.
- **Multi-node routes** (priced): 4×Slice(64 B)+Concat(+ones)[1,5,4,4]+1×1-Conv-placer ≈ 669 F32 /
  ≈ 497 u8-QLinearConv; Equal-tail needs a 900 B padded canvas; any full-canvas intermediate
  ≥ 3,600 B. ALL > 210.

Second-pass kills (2026-06-07, "one more shot" sweep): **sub-byte W packing** — params =
element count, dtype-blind (`calculate_params`; scoring_internals A.2's "dtype-aware bytes"
claim is stale onnx-tool lore — see task055 probe); **sparse W** — task337 triple-fatal;
**zero-param generators** (Range/ConstantOfShape/Trilu/EyeLike) — outputs charged as
intermediates AND Conv takes one data input; **Constant-with-sparse_value** — output charged
800 B; **LRN** (cross-channel, attr-only) — no spatial shift, no placement; **LSTM/GRU/RNN** —
need charged Reshape/Transpose feeds; **Hardmax(axis=1)** — fires ch0 on all-zero padding;
**RoiAlign/GridSample/Col2Im/D2S/ConvInteger** — charged feeds, param taxes, or wrong final
shape; **per-channel w_scale (QLinearConv)** — multiplicative, can't synthesize the additive
−3/−6; **y_zero_point** — per-tensor, u8-positive only.

**Floor = 210** unless a new op family with free shifted cross-channel reads is found.

Prompt lever checked: W has 14/200 nonzero coefficients and dead output channels
1,2,3,7,8, but the only sub-210 single-node possibility is the bias-free groups=2 Conv
at 200 params. It remains infeasible: for ch0, let group-0 coefficients on
`in0(t00), in4(t00), in0(t01), in0(t10), in0(t11)` be `a,b,c,d,e`. Ghost-safety to
the right/below the 4x4 output block forces `a<=0`, `c<=0`, and `d<=0`. Correct bg
inside the block needs `a+c+d+e>0`, while the TR-colored case needs `a+d+e<=0`.
Since `c<=0`, these two inequalities contradict. Therefore a real bias is mandatory,
and ONNX Conv charges the full B[10].

#104 factorization/decomposition check: the exact affine map over the live tap features
has rank 5 when the constant column is included. A cropped-low-rank route with a final
ConvTranspose/placer only beats 210 if it has at most two latent feature planes; the
full-read r=2 price is already `2*(40 W + 1 B + 10 placer + 64 memory)=230`, and the
cheaper grouped r=2 price gives one latent per input group, which cannot separate
both `(bg,ch4)` on group 0 and `(ch5,ch6,ch9)` on group 1. Any pre-shifted 1x1 mix
also pays at least four 4x4 F32 tap intermediates (256 B) before mixing, exceeding the
entire 210 budget. Sparse/sub-byte W, QLinearConv, ConvInteger, Gather/Scatter, and
zero-param generators remain killed for the same scorer reasons above. No candidate
was staged; do not stage a 210 tie.

## Don't-do log

- Don't crop [1,10,8,8] first (LIVE's sin): 2,560 B for data the rule reads 64 cells of.
- Don't use bias to inject the bg constant in a groups=1 placer-conv — positive bias fires
  outside the active block (B[0]=+1 ⇒ ch0 > 0 across the whole canvas). Negative biases are safe.
- Don't try groups=5/10 single-conv (cross-group reads required — see floor proof).
- Don't bother with sparse initializers for W sparsity (scorer-fatal, core.md).
- f16 conversion: NO WIN on this graph class (2026-05-20, cast overhead).
- v1-class designs need NO purity assumption — prefer when staging byte-safety siblings; the
  one-hot-sum identity (IG) is the general bg/confinement constant for placer-convs.
